resources.string: Shows a small button in your apps and places translations over the text on screen.

Sayang Translate sends the text you translate to Google's Gemini, using your own key. Google's terms for that key apply.

Text already in your languages is checked on the phone and never sent.

It only reads notifications from the apps you choose, and the round button only reads the screen while it's switched on. It switches back off when you change apps.

The app has no server and collects nothing.
The round button switches between your language, this one, and Off.
Never translate text that\'s already in my language
Free from Google. It gives the best translations and understands slang. Without one, translation runs on the phone and is weaker.
New messages arrive as a notification in %1$s and %2$s.
No Gemini key yet, so translation runs on the phone and is weaker.
You\'re all set. Nothing else is needed.
Turn on Sayang Translate. If it\'s greyed out, open App info, tap ⋮ at the top, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Tap the small round button in an app. Each tap switches between %1$s, %2$s and Off. It goes back to Off when you change apps.
Turn on Sayang Translate here, and a small round button appears in your apps.
Banking, payment and password apps are left out unless you tick them.
Hold the round button to hide it. Tap Translate in the notification panel to show or hide it.
Pull down the panel, tap the pencil icon, and drag Translate up.
Version %1$s. New versions install by themselves.
Checking and downloading. This can take a minute…
The app is free and open source. If it helps you, you can buy the developer a coffee.
Allow updates first, then check again.
Version %1$s is ready. Tap to allow Sayang Translate to install updates.
Tap to install the new version.
Turn the round button back on
The update switched off the round translate button. Tap to turn it on again.
Language pack download failed. Check your internet.
